protocol: 55341 development rows and 9225 confirmation rows held out first, by conversation. Grouped 5-fold cross-validation with 3 seeds (each seed its own fold assignment, stratified on the emotion). Stage 1: successive halving of 34 configurations on 2 folds with budgets [8, 16, 32] epochs. Stage 2: 10 configurations x 15 runs, AdamW, warm-up 1 epoch, cosine decay to 0.1 of the rate, EMA 0.999, early stopping on the weighted validation cross-entropy (patience 10, at most 100 epochs). Loss: cross-entropy of the sentiment + task weight x cross-entropy of the emotion, the weight searched over [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]; hard labels, label smoothing searched. Selection by the mean of the macro-F1 scores of the readings. Learning-rate grid [0.000241, 0.000724, 0.00217] from the range test. Temperatures sentiment 1.037, emotion 1.098 fitted on out-of-fold logits.
